what: a torus (R 10, r 5) cut by a disc of radius 5 centred at (15,0) in the XZ plane revolved about Z (the disc overlaps the torus tube)
method: both are coaxial rings, so the cut removes the revolution of the lens where the two circles (centres 10 and 15, r 5) overlap. Lens area = 2 r^2 acos(d/2r) - d/2 sqrt(4r^2 - d^2) = 30.709, centroid x = 12.5 by symmetry. V = 2 pi^2 10 25 - 2 pi 12.5 A_lens = 2522.9. Area (Pappus for curves): arc of the tube circle outside the disc (240 degrees, centroid x 10 - 5 sin(120)/(2 pi/3)) and arc of the disc circle inside the tube (120 degrees, centroid x 15 - 5 sin(60)/(pi/3)), each turned 2 pi about Z. Two toroidal faces.
